script: You make a simple poster with a clear headline, with the class times and a phone number. You use one main picture, from a free library, and you keep the colours to three. Then you write a short caption for your portfolio: the centre had no clear poster for the new term, and this design gives parents the times in five seconds. Notice that the caption explains the problem and the result. Clients want to see that you think about their goals, not only about the design. Keep quality high. Place the main subject where the lines cross, not in the exact centre. Use no more than three colours and two fonts in one design. Leave empty space around text. Check spelling twice, and read the text aloud once. Finally, test your portfolio on a phone, because most clients will open it there first.
